subject.title: feat: chat welcome shows an animated Clawd hero and recent chats instead of canned suggestions

question: Should the animated Clawd hero and recent-session list become the default empty-chat experience, with suggestions shown only when no other eligible user session exists?
rationale: Current code provides suitable implementation seams, but no established contract decides this prominent default UX or whether existing users should lose the suggestion shortcuts as soon as another resumable session exists.

options.title: Approve the combined redesign
options.body: Adopt the animated hero and the proposed recent-session eligibility and pure-recency rules together after final proof and conflict resolution.

options.title: Split visual and navigation work
options.body: Land the mascot, badge removal, and layout changes while retaining suggestions until the recent-session replacement policy is separately approved.

options.title: Retain the current welcome
options.body: Keep the static welcome and persistent suggestion shortcuts as the product default.

recommendation.title: Approve the combined redesign
recommendation.body: Adopt the animated hero and the proposed recent-session eligibility and pure-recency rules together after final proof and conflict resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: His merged history owns both the mascot direction and the recent Control UI session organization used by this feature.
